name: Koikeeper — Koi Lineage Measurement (Demo)
description: DEMO vertical agent card for koi fish lineage measurement using Council of AI infrastructure. Not a live service. Demonstrates how a domain-specific measurement vertical would declare its A2A agent card alongside councilof.ai's measurement rails. A koi lineage card records observations (growth, pattern, parentage claims) with evidence links, using the same card-v1 schema as every other measurement card. Measurement, not certification — no pedigree grades, no breed rankings. The card-v1 surface for koi lineage is pending registration; this card is a structural demo.

skills.name: koi-lineage-card
skills.description: DEMO. Produce a sample unsigned koi lineage measurement card following the card-v1 schema (https://councilof.ai/schema/card-v1.json). Accepts lineage observation data (fish id, parentage claims, growth measurements, pattern notes, photo URLs). Returns a card structure with sha256 computed over the canonical body. The card is UNSIGNED and NOT in the public root — it is a structural demo, not a live measurement. To become a real measurement, the card would need to be signed by did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1 and committed to the Merkle root via publish_public_root.py. Measurement, not certification.

demo_note: This is a structural demo of how a vertical agent card would look. No live measurement service exists behind this card. The card-v1 surface enum does not yet include a koi-lineage surface.
